label: REFINE of the held list label: a concrete object or activity noun used attributively before another noun (noun-modifier compounds like 'popcorn machine', 'compost bin', 'vending machine', 'tape recorder'); the pole fires on the modifier noun itself, and plain adjectives in the same frames stay quiet. The old label (popcorn/balloon/compost household-or-party items only) is too narrow: probes show 'vending machine' fires 0.338, 'record player' 0.157, 'trash bin' 0.215.

qc.label_under_test: Low-confidence guess: the nouns popcorn, balloon and compost (and similar household or party items) used before another noun ('a popcorn party', 'balloon releases', 'the compost bin'); other food or household nouns in the same frames stay lower.

short: attributive object/activity noun before another noun
notes: Card top examples: popcorn, balloon, tape, blackout, paragliding, snack, ironing as modifiers; logit effect promotes ' machine',' system',' gun',' iron'.
